title: Lincoln Bishop University set to join Global University Systems
summary_en: Global University Systems (GUS) has announced plans to take ownership of Lincoln Bishop University, in a move it says will strengthen the university’s “local, national and international impact” and ensure its long-term financial sustainability.
author: Kim Martin
title_cn: Lincoln Bishop University set to join Global University Systems

title: Cormack Consultancy Group launches partnership intelligence service
summary_en: Cormack Consultancy Group (CCG) has launched Collaborizer, a new service designed to help universities identify and prioritise international research and transnational education (TNE) partnership opportunities.
author: Kim Martin
title_cn: Cormack Consultancy Group launches partnership intelligence service

title: International students prove a fiscal win for the Netherlands, CPB finds
summary_en: International students are a net positive for the Dutch government’s finances over their lifetimes, despite the costs of educating them, according to a new report from the Dutch Bureau for Economic Policy Analysis (CPB).
author: Kim Martin
title_cn: International students prove a fiscal win for the Netherlands, CPB finds

title: Rubio’s student visa revocations ruled “retaliatory”
summary_en: Stanford University’s student newspaper has won a legal challenge over the US State Department, whose F-1 visa revocations and deportations of students expressing pro-Palestine views have been ruled illegal.
author: Polly Nash

title: Canada lures dozens of scientists from the US
summary_en: Forty-eight leading researchers are leaving US institutions in favour of Canada, as part of the country’s CAD$500 million talent attraction scheme.
author: Polly Nash
title_cn: Canada lures dozens of scientists from the US

title: Three takeaways from Voyage’s latest US outbound student report
summary_en: Voyage's latest report draws on 48 months of Google search data and thousands of real student conversations captured, offering a fresh perspective on what US students are actively searching for, alongside what they are actually discussing.
author: Kim Martin
title_cn: Three takeaways from Voyage’s latest US outbound student report
